title: Panel Port
description: The ports this panel answers on. Both are read from the files that hold them, so what you see here is what the server is actually running.

external.title: Panel port
external.description: The port your browser connects to. Changing it reloads nginx and is checked straight away; if nothing answers on the new port, the old one is put back before you are told.

backend.title: Backend port
backend.description: The port nginx passes requests to internally. It is rarely worth changing, and only useful when another service on this server already wants the number.
backend.restartNote: Changing this restarts the panel, so it is unreachable for a few seconds. If it does not come back on the new port, everything is put back automatically and the result appears here.

change.confirmExternal: The panel will answer on port {{port}} from now on, and the address you are using right now will stop working. Open the new one before closing this tab.
change.confirmBackend: The panel restarts to move its backend to port {{port}} and is unreachable for a few seconds. If it does not come back, the old port is restored automatically.
change.startedBody: The panel is restarting. This screen will show the result as soon as it is back; you do not need to do anything.

outcome.running: A port change is in progress.
outcome.succeeded: The port change finished and was verified.
outcome.rolled_back: The port change failed, and the previous port was put back.
outcome.rollback_failed: The port change failed and the previous port did not come back. This server has to be reached another way.

history.title: Earlier changes
history.none: No port has been changed yet.

error.load: The panel's ports could not be read.
error.change: The port could not be changed.

reason.panel_port_out_of_range: That is not a port number.
reason.panel_port_reserved: Another service on this server answers on that port.
reason.panel_port_in_app_range: Ports 30000 to 30999 are closed at the firewall for tenant applications, so the panel would be unreachable there.
reason.panel_port_unchanged: The panel is already on that port.
reason.panel_port_in_use: Something is already listening on that port.
reason.panel_port_unknown_kind: That is not a port this screen can move.
reason.panel_port_directive_not_found: The setting could not be found where it belongs, so nothing was written.
reason.panel_port_change_in_progress: A port change is already running. Wait for it to finish.
reason.panel_port_verification_failed: Nothing answered on the new port, so the change was undone.
reason.panel_port_rolled_back: Nothing answered on the new port, so the previous one was put back.
reason.panel_port_rollback_failed: The change failed and the previous port did not come back. This server has to be reached another way.
reason.panel_port_host_unreadable: The files that hold the ports could not be read, so nothing was changed.
